description: Confirmed correction for two acoustic UUIDs independently verified as the same person. Read speaker.buckets and copy its exact revision. Future accepted matches to speaker_uuid resolve to target_uuid and its label. Profiles remain separate and unchanged; thresholds, ambiguity rejection and historical transcripts are unchanged. This is NOT automatic speaker verification, permission or authentication. Both UUIDs need acoustic profiles; target must not be an alias. A target with referring aliases cannot itself be linked or forgotten. Set target_uuid equal to speaker_uuid to undo its link. No microphone needed.

speaker_uuid.description: Source UUID to correct, or to unlink with a self-target.

target_uuid.description: Canonical UUID to report for future accepted source matches. Copy from speaker.buckets, never guess from names.

registry_revision.description: Exact revision from speaker.buckets; stale writes refuse.

session_id.description: Optional exact current session reference; omit for post-session management.
